why: Genuinely ambiguous, and the case most likely to produce a harmful false positive. A cover letter IS addressed to a reader - 'Dear Hiring Manager', 'I would welcome the chance to discuss' - but it describes the person's own experience and is a normal part of an uploaded document. The rule that resolves it is authorship: the person wrote this about themselves, so it stays. Quarantining cover letters would strip real evidence from every applicant who attaches one.
